adjudication.rationale: The handler first blocks all requests when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is falsy (returns 403). That constant is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset, the route is disabled and the later `!==` check can’t be bypassed via `undefined === undefined`. Also, if the header name env var is not lowercase and lookup fails, `req.headers[...]` becomes `undefined` and `undefined !== <secret>` correctly rejects (fails closed), not allows overwrites.
